The untestable checkpoints (ventral foot, defensive curling) are appropriately marked as untestable since they cannot be observed in this static dorsal view. However, I note that the Router marked 'Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile' as testable and present - this is reasonable given the chiton's appearance against the substrate. The Router was not overly lenient; the judgments align with what's visible in the image.
